reader.requirement: At --std 85 a RENAMES entry must be refused when any item within its range (with THRU, every item from data-name-2 through data-name-3 and data-name-3's subordinates; without THRU, data-name-2 and its subordinates) is a variable occurrence data item, i.e. (§1985 definition) a table element carrying OCCURS DEPENDING ON or subordinate to such an element, while a range that stops before such an item stays legal.

edition-consulted.switches: how data-name-2/-3 are resolved before the range screen (whole-scope candidates filtered to the record below 2002, the record's subtree from 2002); RenamesRangeFault itself does not consult the edition

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry/Std in ResolveRedefinesPass.cs found none; RenamesRangeFault and VariableLengthCompatibility.IsVariableLengthDataItem take no edition. The only consult on the path is operand resolution (RegionClauseCandidates).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (for the range content; operand resolution differs, see SR4's record)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises legal ranges that stop before an ODO table; ranges that reach an ODO table through a group operand, a no-THRU group operand and a nested group are not exercised by it

probes.printed: error COBOL2561: 'X' RENAMES A THRU G: 'T' is an occurs-depending table
probes.expected: refusal: T (OCCURS DEPENDING ON) lies in G, so within A THRU G

probes.printed: error COBOL2561: 'X' RENAMES G: 'T' is an occurs-depending table
probes.expected: refusal: no-THRU range is G with its variable occurrence subordinate

probes.printed: error COBOL2561: 'X' RENAMES B THRU H: 'T' is an occurs-depending table
probes.expected: refusal: the ODO table sits under data-name-3 two levels down
legal: ranges A THRU B and A stop before the ODO group table; values ABCDE and AB

probes.printed: error COBOL2740: data-name-3 'T1' is subject to an OCCURS clause (of 'T')
probes.expected: refusal (an item subordinate to a variable occurrence element as data-name-3; SR3 also bars it)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.11.3 SR6  (║5.11.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR6

reader.notes: RenamesRangeFault walks the record's entries from data-name-2 to the end of data-name-3's subtree and refuses any entry with OCCURS DEPENDING ON; a variable occurrence subordinate item can only be inside such a table, so it is covered. The 2023-only shapes it also screens (dynamic-length items, object/pointer usages) cannot be written at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Read ResolveRedefinesPass.cs#RenamesRangeFault: the range is the record's entries in source order from data-name-2 to the end of data-name-3's subtree, so a data-name-3 that is an ANCESTOR of data-name-2 still reaches the ODO table. Probes at --std 85: w1 (66 X RENAMES G1 THRU G, G1 the first child of G and the ODO table T the last) -> COBOL2561 'T is an occurs-depending table'; w2 (A THRU G1 and A, ranges that stop before the ODO table inside the same group) -> exit 0 [PQR|PQ|R] (MOVE through the alias writes A and G1); w3 (FD record, data-name-3 the ODO table itself) -> COBOL2740 under SR3 (also barred by SR3; refused either way). Every 1985 variable occurrence data item is an ODO table or its subordinate (§1985 definition), and the 2023-only arms of the screen cannot be written at 85. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.11.3 SR6 the text is in SR6.
